title: Space used by the branch machine
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a Boolean, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. The total number of work-tape cells visited by the branch machine through time $t$, starting from its initial configuration on $x$, is the space used by $M_1$ through time $t$ plus the number of work tapes of $M_2$ when $b$ is true; when $b$ is false, it is the space used by $M_2$ through time $t$ plus the number of work tapes of $M_1$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Boolean machines M₁ and M₂
